summary.text: Annie McDaniel is a Democratic state representative from South Carolina House District 41 who has served since November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is an accountant and a former Fairfield County school board member.

paragraphs.text: Annie McDaniel was born in Winnsboro, South Carolina, and her career experience includes working as an accountant.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of South Carolina in 1982 and a graduate degree from the university in 1991.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she served on the Fairfield County School District Board of Trustees from 2000 to 2018.
McDaniel assumed office on November 12, 2018, succeeding MaryGail Douglas.
In the survey she said that when elected in 2018 she was the first African American woman, and the first African American since Reconstruction, to hold the District 41 seat.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee.
She named social justice and health care as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
The Democratic primary for the 2026 election was canceled.
